summary: Iteration 19 backend testing: 17/17 tests passed. Verified GET /api/admin/users/{id}/downline-tree (auth/403, 404 unknown user, max_depth clamp to [1..8], non-empty L1 for super admin EG000001, members sorted by total_earnings DESC, sub_admin allowed). Verified withdraw_nudge idempotency by directly invoking mlm_engine._distribute_level_commissions against a synthetic downstream buyer after setting admin wallet_balance=495 — exactly ONE notification with event='withdraw_nudge', action_url='/wallet', title mentioning ₹500 was inserted; withdraw_nudge_sent flag flipped True; second commission credit did NOT insert a second nudge. Regression on 10 previously-live endpoints (admin users list/detail, commission-breakdown x2, login-history, activity, search, change-password wrong-current reject, reset-password requires super_admin, fresh-start rejects without confirm) all pass. State fully restored after nudge test (buyer deleted, notifications/txns purged, admin balance/flags restored).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin_user_downline_tree: `max(1, min(int(max_depth or 8), 8))` treats max_depth=0 as falsy and defaults to 8 (not 1). Not a spec violation, but if intent is clamp-to-[1,8] then use `max(1, min(int(max_depth if max_depth is not None else 8), 8))`.

mlm_engine._distribute_level_commissions: nudge is computed from `new_balance = float(sponsor.get('wallet_balance', 0)) + amount` using the sponsor snapshot BEFORE the $inc. If multiple credits happen in the same order chain (unlikely in current code) or admin sends manual credits between reads, snapshot could drift. Consider re-reading the user after $inc to compute the real balance for the nudge threshold check.

mlm_engine.get_downline_tree traverses by `sponsor_user_id` (recursive tree) while the admin downline-tree endpoint traverses by `sponsor_id` (user_code, level-grouped). Two sources of truth for the same relationship — document the difference or unify.

Backend downline_tree fields projection omits `sponsor_id` from returned members; tests can't verify sponsor linkage from the response. Consider adding sponsor_id to the projected fields for transparency in the admin UI.
